$description: Login gate token ledger — the colours the login surface ships, in the Design Tokens Community Group format. Every token here is a CSS custom property declared on .login-page / .dark .login-page in src/app/globals.css. Each $description carries its measured WCAG ratio so the reason travels with the token. Ratios are computed, never rounded up; APCA Lc is advisory and reported alongside.

cta.$description: Primary CTA fill, both themes. White label text = 4.80:1 (SC 1.4.3 pass). Replaces brand-500 (#E56A4A), which gave white text only 3.23:1 — a FAIL. APCA Lc -78.

cta-hover.$description: CTA hover fill. White label text = 6.21:1. Deepens on hover, so the accent stays singular while the pressed state reads.

field-border.$description: Input boundary, both themes. 3.47:1 against the field fill (SC 1.4.11 floor 3:1). The shared Input's brand-tinted 40% border measured 1.19:1 — no perceptible edge.

focus-ring-light.$description: Light-theme focus indicator. 4.71:1 vs field fill, 4.98:1 vs page (SC 1.4.11 floor 3:1, SC 2.4.13 appearance). 2px outline, 2px offset.

focus-ring-dark.$description: Dark-theme focus indicator. 5.44:1 vs field fill, 7.17:1 vs page. APCA Lc -53.

placeholder-light.$description: Light-theme placeholder. 4.61:1 vs field fill (SC 1.4.3 floor 4.5, placeholder text included).

placeholder-dark.$description: Dark-theme placeholder. 5.20:1 vs field fill. APCA Lc -47.

eyebrow-light.$description: Light-theme 'THE HARBOR GATE' eyebrow and feature icons. 6.16:1 on the card (icons are meaningful, floor 3:1).

feature-icon-dark.$description: Dark-theme feature-list icons. 6.48:1 on the card. Replaces the brand-400/80 alpha form, whose 80% opacity dropped the icons toward the icon-contrast floor.

warn-light.$description: Light-theme warning copy (caps-lock, SSO incomplete, no-password risk). 4.98:1 on the card (SC 1.4.3 pass at 12px).

warn-dark.$description: Dark-theme warning copy. 9.76:1 on the card. APCA Lc -72.

error-light.$description: Light-theme error copy, including the shared Input's own error slot. 6.41:1 on the card. The shared component's text-red-500 measured 3.73:1 — a FAIL at 12px.

error-dark.$description: Dark-theme error copy. 6.03:1 on the card. APCA Lc -47.

footer.$description: Footer status line and constellation caption, 11px. Resolves to --color-text-muted: light 4.65:1 on the page, dark 6.86:1. Replaces --color-text-subtle, which gave 2.52:1 (light) and 3.37:1 (dark) — both FAIL at 11px.
